publications.title: Tool-Genesis: A Task-Driven Tool Creation Benchmark for Self-Evolving Language Agent
publications.summary: A diagnostic benchmark for whether agents can build task-relevant MCP tools from abstract requirements alone, scored from interface compliance and functional correctness to downstream utility.
highlights: Four-level evaluation: server startup, schema fidelity, functional correctness, and downstream task utility

publications.title: Agent2World: Learning to Generate Symbolic World Models via Adaptive Multi-Agent Feedback
publications.summary: Research, development, and testing agents turn natural-language environment descriptions into PDDL domains or executable Python simulators, repaired through adaptive unit tests and simulation feedback.
highlights: Evaluated on Text2World, CWMB, and ByteSized32

publications.title: OWL: Optimized Workforce Learning for General Multi-Agent Assistance in Real-World Task Automation
publications.summary: A hierarchical multi-agent framework that separates planning, coordination, and specialized execution, with reinforcement learning for cross-domain planner generalization.
highlights: 69.70% on GAIA, reported as open-source state of the art

publications.title: Enhancing Transformer-based Models for Long Sequence Time Series Forecasting via Structured Matrix
publications.summary: Structured surrogate attention and feed-forward blocks for improving efficiency while retaining expressive power in long-sequence forecasting.
highlights: 12.4% average performance improvement across reported experiments
